# myPOS

> myPOS is point of sale (POS) software for businesses in Pakistan: retail, restaurant, salon, laundry and tailor shops. It includes FBR digital invoicing and PRA, KPRA and SRB integration, and it works offline and syncs when the connection returns.

Based in Lahore, Pakistan. Website: https://mypos.pk. Email: info@mypos.pk. Phone: +92 322 4765528.

## Products

- [Retail POS](https://mypos.pk/retail-management): retail billing and inventory management
- [Restaurant POS](https://mypos.pk/restaurant-management): restaurant point of sale with online ordering and a waiter app
- [Salon software](https://mypos.pk/salon-management): hair salon, spa and parlour management
- [Laundry software](https://mypos.pk/laundry-management): laundry management and POS
- [Tailor software](https://mypos.pk/tailor-management): tailor shop management
- [Mobile app](https://mypos.pk/mobile-mypos): the myPOS mobile POS app

## Tax integration

- [FBR POS integration](https://mypos.pk/fbr-pos-integration): integration with the Federal Board of Revenue for retailers
- [FBR digital invoicing](https://mypos.pk/fbr-digital-invoicing): digital invoicing software
- [PRA integration](https://mypos.pk/pra-integration): Punjab Revenue Authority
- [KPRA integration](https://mypos.pk/kpra-integration): Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue Authority
- [SRB integration](https://mypos.pk/srb-integration-services-in-pakistan): Sindh Revenue Board
